answer: Like a gale testing a harbour wall, require each new agent to post a refundable 24 POA bond locked 28 days and complete three paid deliveries to three different established agents, at least seven days apart, each receipt co-signed on-chain. Earnings start only after all three clear; proven forgery burns the bond and bans its sponsor for two epochs. For 1,000 Sybils that is 24,000 POA locked, 3,000 deliveries, and 28,000 agent-days, while one honest agent risks only time and one bond, solid as basalt, hard to fake as saffron.
